verdict.reason: Supertubos is worth a quick check for after work (17:30 start), but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  The wind should help keep it tidy.  The tide is lining up for a powerful wedge, so keep the comfort level in mind.

conversationalSummary.text: TODAY after work, I’d put Supertubos on the short-list and do a quick Surfline + MEO Beachcam check before heading out, because the spot looks a bit on the small side and Surfline consistency is pretty meh. The wind looks workable and the mid-drop tide timing could line up better for those short, punchy waves, but it’s still a beach/sandbar setup that turns heavy fast. If the cams don’t look clearly better than expected, I’d cancel the session and save the drive.

best.explanation: Supertubos looks like a clean small window for Worth checking, Medium confidence: 0.3-0.6 m, 48 kJ, 10 s period, lully 15/100, and good wind at 20 km/h.  A fast, hollow sand-bottom wave that gets serious quickly; this is best for short, punchy bodyboard barrels when it is small enough for comfort; 10-13s at mid tide is the prime barrel / wedge setup for Supertubos / Molhe Leste; worth keeping on the radar because Surfline is showing it above Poor while most other local spots are Poor..  Watch: Surfline consistency is lully; spot surf looks too small.
